{{inline |date=May 2024}}
In [[geometric data analysis]] and [[statistical shape analysis]], '''principal geodesic analysis''' is a generalization of [[principal component analysis]] to a [[Euclidean geometry|non-Euclidean]], non-linear setting of [[manifolds]] suitable for use with [[Shape analysis (digital geometry)#Shape descriptors|shape descriptors]] such as [[medial representation]]s.

==References==
* [http://midag.cs.unc.edu/pubs/papers/TMI04_Fletcher_PGA.pdf Principal Geodesic Analysis for the Study of Nonlinear Statistics of Shape]
* [https://papers.nips.cc/paper/5133-probabilistic-principal-geodesic-analysis.pdf Probabilistic Principal Geodesic Analysis]
* [https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-662-44848-9_6 Kernel Principal Geodesic Analysis]
* [https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-030-33226-6_21 Mixture Probabilistic Principal Geodesic Analysis]
